verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Microsoft Copilot's consumer-facing chat/assistant features (Word, Excel, browsing, connectors) but contains no mention of admin controls, member/permission management, or organizational data policy governance—these are typically handled in Microsoft 365 admin center / Purview, not documented here. Missing for 10: any docs on admin console, role/permission management, org-wide data policy configuration, or tenant-level governance controls.
